result.stdout:
Usage: dotnet-api-template new --project-name <name> [options]

Scaffolds a clean-architecture ASP.NET Core Web API. The project name is applied
across the board: the solution, every project, every assembly and every namespace.

Options:
  -n, --project-name <name>          Name of the project. Becomes the solution name, every project name, assembly name and root namespace.
  -o, --output <path>                Directory to create the project in. [default: current directory]
  -k, --kafka-topic-prefix <prefix>  Prefix for every Kafka topic, the consumer group and the Redis key namespace. [default: derived from the project name]
  -p, --api-port <port>              Host port Docker Compose publishes the API on. [default: 5080]
  -d, --database-name <name>         PostgreSQL database name. [default: appdb]
  -g, --allow-grpc                   Add a gRPC surface alongside REST, sharing the same query handlers.
  --no-tests                         Omit the unit and integration test projects.
  --no-docs                          Omit the docs/ folder.
  --no-env                           Do not create .env with generated secrets.
  --no-git                           Do not run git init and the first commit.
  --no-restore                       Skip the automatic dotnet restore.
  --force                            Overwrite an existing directory.
  --dry-run                          Print what would happen without writing anything.
  -h, --help                         Show this help.

Examples:

  dotnet-api-template new --project-name Acme.Billing
  dotnet-api-template new --project-name Acme.Billing --allow-grpc --kafka-topic-prefix billing
  dotnet-api-template new -n Acme.Billing -o ~/src -p 6000 -d billingdb
  dotnet-api-template new -n Acme.Billing --dry-run
